label: Matched good-favouring table, by computation
description: A placed diagnostic for 4be0f774. By construction, at the actual standard the proxy, D-nature, determined will, good-general nature and rational exercise explain the same contrasts (c rather than z or omission) and none explains c rather than the tied d; chance explains nothing; a bias that is not good-bounded selects c. The assignment of profiles to accounts is interpretive: rational exercise is assigned the good-tracking profile and the determined will the D-tracking one, and whether rational favouring tracks goodness through apprehension under counterpossible variation is the open content-generality question. Reversal separates the proxy from D-tracking; goodness variation at fixed D-realization separates D-tracking from good-tracking. The D-nature favours the better c over z with ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 and without BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 or ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2. Controls show that perverse and biased favouring do not count as dependence on goodness. Establishes no premise.
